attempts.text:
**The window starts in a seven-column spine.** Columns 0 to 6, `proB` to `yafP`, are persistent, carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, and in a region of plasticity in 0 to 8% of calls. The model names 78 to 99.8% of them, fewest at `yafP`, 78%, where it hesitates 1.69 bits.

**Then two fork and variable columns**, 7 and 8, in a region of plasticity in 9% of calls, named 88 to 95%. A fork at column 7 carries a type II toxin-antitoxin family in 66% of chromosomes and `ykfJ` in 23%; column 8, variable, carries a type I toxin-antitoxin family in 70%.

**A short spine follows**, columns 9 and 10, `dinB` and `lafU`, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 11 to 12% of calls, named 89 to 94%. Column 11 is a fork, in a region of plasticity in 20% of calls, named 85%, carrying `rayT` in 75% and `motA` in 17%.

**Columns 21 to 79 are fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 12 to 76% of calls, named 65 to 94%. The model is most hesitant at column 22, 2.19 bits, and names fewest at column 21, 65%. A second branch of 30 families runs through columns 22 to 51, carried by 15 to 17% of chromosomes, [[flagellar basal body and export]]. The window ends at column 79, `fhuB`, in 13% of chromosomes.

label: proB
facts:
WINDOW: the proB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor proB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,453 to 3,532 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying proB once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.53 bits on average (perplexity 1.8 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 26,715 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 15,525 calls, named 78%, 0.97 bits; cloud 880 calls, named 25%, 3.91 bits. Outside an RGP 29,580 calls, named 96%, 0.23 bits; inside an RGP 13,540 calls, named 74%, 1.19 bits. Columns: 16 spine, 36 fork, 28 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.19 against 0.23 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 96%); 13,540 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 22 ("hypothetical protein") 2.19 bits, RGP 74%; column 21 (ydcC) 1.95 bits, RGP 70%; column 23 (dnaQ) 1.77 bits, RGP 76%. The 22 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 0.85 bits on average; the other 58 columns: named 92%, 0.42 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 21-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 12-76%; the least: columns 0-6 (spine), RGP 0-8%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-6 (7 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-8%. Genes: proB, phoE, crl, frsA, gpt, pepD, yafP "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase". named 78-99.8% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6 (yafP), named 78%, 1.69 bits.
2. columns 7-8 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 9%. named 88-95% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 7, named 88%, 0.95 bits.
   7 fork: yafO S 66% "type II toxin-antitoxin system mRNA…"; also ykfJ S 23%
   8 variable: yafN S 70% "type I toxin-antitoxin system antit…"
3. columns 9-10 (2 columns) spine: share 94-95%, all P, RGP 11-12%. Genes: dinB, lafU. named 89-94% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 9 (dinB), named 89%; most hesitant at column 10 (lafU), 0.72 bits.
4. column 11 fork: RGP 20%. named 85%; 0.73 bits.
   11: rayT S 75%; also motA S 17%
5. column 12 spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 21%. Genes: yafL "C40 family peptidase". named 92%; 0.59 bits.
6. columns 13-14 (2 columns) fork: RGP 22%. named 87-89% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 14, named 87%, 0.50 bits.
   13: dinJ S 66%; also "flagellar basal body-associated FliL fa…" S 16%
   14: yafQ S 50% "type II toxin-antitoxin system mRNA…"; also "flagellar hook-length control protein F…" S 16%
7. columns 15-20 (6 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 22-46%. Genes: dpaA, yafJ "class II glutamine amidotransferase", lpcA, fadE, ivy, yafV "amidohydrolase". named 79-95% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (yafV), named 79%, 1.13 bits.
